text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was as the Takarazuka Kinen approached, 
under the sprawling early summer sky—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: This is the last one, Laurel-san!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Okaaay! Take the time for the last one, 
Chiyo-chan!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Here I gooo!! Ready... BAKUSHINNN!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Dadadadada!!)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Awesome, awesome! Laurel-san, your time 
improved again!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Our special training on the freestyle 
racecourse in preparation for European 
turf... is yielding more and more results! 
Truly a case of "blades of grass gather to 
make a beautiful forest"!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thanks, Chiyo-chan♪ Running with the 
amateur girls who usually compete here 
seemed to be a great inspiration, too.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, with this—I think I can go without 
any regrets.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Ohh! In other words, at long last...! You 
are departing for France, Laurel-san!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, definitely before the summer 
training camp. I want to get completely 
used to the environment over there.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
“—I used to worry that staying in an 
unfamiliar environment for too long might 
ruin my health... and things like that, 
but.”

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
More than that, right now I just want to 
think about getting stronger!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"Our schedule for the prep race is set. 
Time to fire ourselves up!"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: —Gasp! *pant*, *pant*...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ngaaah~! Maya lost the swimming match 
too~?! Maya has to do the grocery run 
again—?!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
The other day, and the grocery run before 
that too!! Maya did the dish cleanup after 
meals, and even set up the tent at the 
start, too~!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...You're the one who said we should 
decide all our chores with a competition, 
aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
And in the end, I was roped into helping 
with almost all of it.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Because, becauseee~~!! Ugh, Maya's totally 
gonna win next time!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Haa... You still have no plans to head 
home?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
If Brian-san isn't going home, then Maya 
isn't going home either!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I've made up my mind! I'm gonna tag along 
on Brian-san's warrior training and get 
way stronger than her!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
So bring on mountain training, river 
swimming, grocery shopping, or whatever 
else you got!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Then go buy some meat.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Ehhhh!! Againnn~?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: So you do complain...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"Hmph! Fine then, I'm just gonna zoom 
right on ahead!"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I'll eat way more than Brian-san and get 
even faster!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: ...Because, surely—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
—That's right☆ Surely under the very same 
sky, everyone else is keeping on running 
too...★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
That's why I'm gonna show everyone at the 
Takarazuka Kinen, too! ☆ Maaaaaaaarvelous! 
★☆★☆★

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WAAAAAAAH!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Takarazuka Kinen. The 
cheers welcoming Marvelous Sunday were 
deafening on their own.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: However—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Fan A
text_block_list.text:
—It's kind of a bummer about this 
Takarazuka, though! Neither Brian nor 
Laurel are in it.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Mayano isn't here either, huh. I actually 
kinda like the face-off dynamic between 
me, Laurel, Mayano, and Marvelous.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Fan A
text_block_list.text:
"I mean, the lineup for the Tenno Sho 
(Spring) was just way too good!! Finding a 
race that beats that is gonna be tough—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—An unsatisfactory race. I was aware that 
some people were saying that.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's probably because that star-studded 
Tenno Sho (Spring) left such a deep 
impression. I almost want to talk back, 
but—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: —Hup☆

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Fans
text_block_list.text: Whoa!?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
I heard you! You guys are totally novel, 
aren't you?☆

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Fans
text_block_list.text: Huh, whaaat!?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Not marvelous, meaning no-velous☆ But 
don't worry! I'll make sure today's race 
turns out completely marvelous too★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Because the world is overflowing with 
Marvelous! It'd be such a waste for things 
to be boring just because you didn't 
notice it☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No sooner had I hurriedly sent her back to 
the paddock than the other competing 
Umamusume, who seemed to have seen the 
commotion, began approaching us.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm amazed. To think you could say 
something like that straight to their 
face."

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I can say it loud and proud☆ Because 
I truly believe in it★☆★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"Because each and every one of you is a 
marvelous Umamusume running in this 
Twinkle Series!!"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
I won't lose to Mayano, Laurel, or even 
Brian! Each and every one of them is a 
walking miracle!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Since I get to run alongside you all, I 
know for sure we'll make it marvelous☆

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. When people said it wasn't 
particularly exciting, I was honestly 
feeling down about it.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Somehow, it just blew all my worries 
away. ...Let's do this!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
"Let's settle this, Marvelous Sunday. 
Let's put on a race that'll blow 
everyone's minds!"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: ...!! MARVELOUSSS!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A clashing heat that blows away any 
lingering traces of spring. The Takarazuka 
Kinen raises its curtains right now—!
